scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
